findings.issue: `norm_repr_eq_of_mem_sphere` is general infrastructure published in the parton GTMD namespace and re-exported through `Parton.Basic`: its statement mentions no `Transverse` and no parton object, only `Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr`, `Metric.sphere` and the norm, and its proof is two upstream rewrites.
`circleAverageTransverse_def` is proved `:= rfl`, publishing the unfolding as a definitional equality and inviting downstream defeq reliance on the `Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI` transport.

summary: The exposed surface has no compatibility residue and the exposure level matches house style, but the new `VectorTmd`/`azimuthalAverage` interface delivers only the physical half of the assumption bundle, so the result cannot be fed to any existing TMD consumer, and `circleAverageTransverse` is published without a name for its integrability hypothesis or any linearity/retraction lemmas. One general norm/sphere lemma is also published in the parton namespace.
